reason: A file-management plugin for organizing plugin package versions in a dist directory, with WebUI and REST operations for archiving, restoring, and cleaning archived packages.

summaries.zh: 用于管理插件分发目录版本的文件工具，可通过 WebUI 归档、恢复和清理旧版插件包。
summaries.en: A file-management tool for organizing plugin package versions in a distribution directory through WebUI-based archiving, restoration, and cleanup.

capabilities: Scans plugin package files in a configured distribution directory
Moves older package versions into an archive directory
Deletes selected or all archived packages
Provides REST API endpoints and a WebUI for archive management
